subtitle: 9 Questions To Ask Before You Hire An Ads Agency
hook_line: Most owners hire an ads agency the same way they pick a coffee shop.
intro: You wouldn't judge a coffee shop by its logo. But most owners judge an agency by their pitch deck, not their numbers.

pairs.strong: "What's our current cost per qualified lead?"
"What's the break-even ROAS for our margins?"
"What's our Quality Score on core keywords?"
"Show me the account structure before we start"
"Where in the funnel are we losing people?"
"Walk me through what changed this month"

closing: The right questions cost nothing and save you thousands in wasted spend.
cta_save: Save this before your next agency call.
cta_question: Which question are you not currently asking?
